problems.problem: heal-1-research.md's fix snippet is mechanically incomplete in two ways, and its own strict-6c instruction is unreachable without fixing both: (a) the revert push has no `force: true`, but rewinding a ref to an ancestor is never a fast-forward, so receive-pack rejects it and the partial fold would persist on every attempt; (b) the revert target is `input.expectedBaseHead`, yet in the witness-refusal case (check 6b) that value is a stale sha naming no object, so `git.branch({object})` can never succeed. A probe of the pre-fix tree confirmed the witness fires AFTER the refused increment's pack reached the remote (remote held 2 commits: base + one land commit), which is why check 6c could not be made strict as instructed.
problems.fix: Applied with two corrections: `force: true` on the compensating revert push (same documented idiom as the notes-mirror push), and the revert targets the tip the FIRST increment's own `onPrePush` discovery reported (`observedBaseHead`) instead of `input.expectedBaseHead`; `pushedAnyIncrement` moved to immediately after the push resolves (before the post-push witness) so the witness-refusal case reverts too. Verified: pre-fix probe count=2, post-fix count=1.
